entries.def:
§ Tahpanhes or Tahapanes or Tehaphnehes = "thou will fill hands with pity"
a city in Egypt; modern 'Tel Defenneh' or 'Tel Defneh' located approx 18 miles (29 km) east southeast from Tanis

A woman of the Egyptians living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.11.19; married to Pharaoh (H6547K); 
mother of: daughter_of_Pharaoh (H6547P) 
§ Tahpenes = "wife of the king"
an Egyptian queen in the times of David and Solomon
corselet

1) to burn, be kindled (of anger)
1a) (Tiphel) to heat oneself in vexation

1) a kind of leather, skin, or animal hide
1a) perhaps the animal yielding the skin
1a1) perhaps the badger or dugong, dolphin, or sheep, or a now extinct animal
